additions.description: GET /api/v1/items/ supports filtering by owner_id implicitly by returning only items owned by the current user if not superuser
additions.reasoning: The specification states that users can create and retrieve their own items, but does not explicitly require filtering items by owner_id in the GET /items endpoint. The code implements this filtering logic.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/items/ does not validate that the title field is non-empty and within length limits beyond Pydantic validation
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires validation of item title length and non-empty title. The code uses Pydantic validators but does not explicitly handle validation errors or return 422 with detailed messages.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/items/ does not return HTTP status code 200 as required by the specification but returns 200 implicitly (FastAPI default) without explicit status code
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires response status code 200 on item creation, but the code does not explicitly set status code 200 or 201, relying on FastAPI defaults.

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} returns 400 for insufficient permissions instead of 403 as might be expected for authorization failures
omissions.reasoning: The specification expects a 400 status code with detail 'Not enough permissions' when a user tries to read an item they do not own, which matches the code. No omission here.

omissions.description: PUT/PATCH /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not explicitly check or reject updates with invalid title or description lengths beyond Pydantic validation
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires validation of title and description lengths on update; code uses Pydantic validators but does not explicitly handle validation errors or return 422 with detailed messages.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not confirm deletion by attempting to retrieve the item afterwards
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires verifying that the item was actually deleted by attempting to retrieve it and expecting 404, but the code does not implement this verification.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/users/signup does not validate password length and email format beyond Pydantic validation and does not return 422 with detailed validation errors
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires password length between 8 and 128 and valid email format with 422 on validation errors; code uses Pydantic validators but does not explicitly handle validation errors or return 422.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/users/signup returns 400 with generic message for duplicate superuser email instead of a distinct error
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires 400 with detail 'The user with this email already exists in the system' for duplicate superuser email; code returns this message but does not distinguish superuser email from others.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/users/signup does not enforce password length constraints strictly, allowing invalid lengths to pass if Pydantic validation is bypassed
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires password length validation; code relies on Pydantic validators but no explicit enforcement or error handling beyond that.

omissions.description: PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password does not reject new passwords that are the same as the current password with a 400 and appropriate message
omissions.reasoning: Code correctly rejects new password same as current with 400 and message 'New password cannot be the same as the current one', matching specification.

omissions.description: PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password does not validate password length constraints strictly beyond Pydantic validation
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires password length validation; code uses Pydantic validators but no explicit error handling or 422 response.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/v1/users/me forbids superusers from deleting themselves with 403 and message, matching specification
omissions.reasoning: Code implements this behavior as required.

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/users/{user_id} returns 403 if user is not superuser and tries to access another user's data, matching specification
omissions.reasoning: Code implements this behavior as required.

omissions.description: PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_id} returns 409 on email conflict, matching specification
omissions.reasoning: Code implements this behavior as required.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id} returns 403 if superuser tries to delete themselves, matching specification
omissions.reasoning: Code implements this behavior as required.

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/not-a-uuid and GET /api/v1/users/not-a-uuid return 422 validation error for invalid UUID format, matching specification
omissions.reasoning: Code relies on FastAPI and Pydantic validation to enforce UUID format and return 422.

omissions.description: Password recovery and reset password endpoints are not implemented
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires password recovery via POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email} and password reset via POST /api/v1/reset-password/, but these endpoints are missing in the code.

omissions.description: No email sending or integration with mailcatcher service for password recovery
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires sending password recovery emails and verifying via mailcatcher service, but code has no email sending or external interaction.

omissions.description: No implementation of user login token test endpoint to verify token and return user email
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires a test token endpoint returning user email, but code does not implement such endpoint.

omissions.description: No implementation of user logout or token revocation
omissions.reasoning: Specification does not explicitly require logout or token revocation, so no omission.

omissions.description: No explicit handling of password reset token validation and error response with detail 'Invalid token'
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires password reset with token validation and error response on invalid token, but code lacks this functionality.

omissions.description: No implementation of user deletion cascade to delete items owned by user
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires that deleting a user deletes their items (implied by test deleting user then item returns 404), but code does not explicitly implement cascade or check item deletion.

omissions.description: No explicit response status codes set for create, update, or delete operations; relies on FastAPI defaults
omissions.reasoning: Specification expects specific status codes (e.g., 200) for operations; code does not explicitly set status codes.
